name: Qianjin de Nuli Jiajiajiu
source:
Loss and disappointment. I was a failure, and I quit my job when I hit rock bottom.
And that's when before me appeared my supervisor, Liu Huixi, dragging a suitcase.

"Something came up, and I can't go home. Can I stay with you for a while...?"

She was one of the main reasons I quit. I wanted to turn her down, but the sniveling corporate worm part of me couldn't refuse. I had no choice but to let her stay with me.

As compensation, she offered something I could never have imagined, and that's when our "slave" play began. She called me "Master", stripped me, and began touching me. What exactly was going on here!?

But, as we spent time together, I learned about a different side of my "superior". Just being around her was not as traumatic as before, in fact, I became interested in her, and I found myself wanting to learn the real reason she wanted to stay with me...

As we created more memories together, my heart began to sway...
translation:
失落和失望。我是个失败者，当我跌入谷底时，我辞掉了工作。
就在这时，我的主管刘惠熙拖着一个行李箱出现在我面前。

“有事，我不能回家。我可以在你身边住一段时间吗……？”

她是我辞职的主要原因之一。我想拒绝她，但我内心哭泣的公司蠕虫无法拒绝。我没办法，只能让她留在我身边。

作为补偿，她提供了我无法想象的东西，我们的“奴隶”游戏就这样开始了。她叫我“主人”，脱掉我的衣服，并开始抚摸我。这里到底发生了什么！？

但是，当我们在一起度过的时间里，我了解到了我的“上级”的另一面。和她在一起并不像以前那么痛苦，事实上，我对她产生了兴趣，我发现自己想了解她想和我在一起的真正原因……

当我们一起创造更多的回忆时，我的心开始摇摆……
